description: Unit tests for the Driver class in the webkitpy layout tests port module, including test cases for command wrapping, URI conversions, block reading, crash detection, and process management.

classes.name: DriverTest
classes.description: Test suite for the Driver class, containing multiple test cases for its methods and behaviors.

methods.name: make_port
methods.description: Creates a Port instance with a mock system host and release configuration.

methods.name: _assert_wrapper
methods.description: Asserts that the command wrapper produces the expected output.

methods.name: test_command_wrapper
methods.description: Tests the command wrapper functionality with various inputs.

methods.name: test_test_to_uri
methods.description: Verifies the test_to_uri method converts test paths to correct URIs.

methods.name: test_uri_to_test
methods.description: Verifies the uri_to_test method converts URIs back to test paths.

methods.name: test_read_block
methods.description: Tests reading a non-binary, non-base64 content block.

methods.name: test_read_binary_block
methods.description: Tests reading a binary content block.

methods.name: test_read_base64_block
methods.description: Tests reading a base64-encoded content block.

methods.name: test_no_timeout
methods.description: Checks command line includes --no-timeout when specified.

methods.name: test_check_for_driver_crash
methods.description: Tests crash detection logic with various crash/error message scenarios.

methods.name: test_creating_a_port_does_not_write_to_the_filesystem
methods.description: Ensures port creation does not write files to the filesystem.

methods.name: test_stop_cleans_up_properly
methods.description: Verifies that stopping the driver cleans up temporary directories.

methods.name: test_two_starts_cleans_up_properly
methods.description: Ensures that starting the driver twice cleans up previous temporary directories.

methods.name: test_start_actually_starts
methods.description: Checks that the driver start method initiates the server process.
